title: 이자제한법 제2조제1항의 최고이자율에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:25376:20140611:00002:part:1/1

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 25376, June 11, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 15, 2014.

Article 2 (Applicability)
This Decree shall apply beginning with the first contract concluded or renewed after this Decree enters into force.
